idea-plugin.name: Fixed Lane Git Graph
idea-plugin.description:
Fixed Lane Git Graph improves the readability of IntelliJ IDEA's Git Log by keeping graph lanes stable and predictable across the visible commit history.

Instead of allowing branches and merge paths to shift columns aggressively as the graph is rendered, the plugin applies a fixed-lane layout strategy inspired by vscode-git-graph. This makes complex histories easier to scan, especially in repositories with long-lived branches, stacked feature work, and frequent merges.

  • Maintains stable lane positions for commits and branch paths
  • Improves readability of merge-heavy histories
  • Handles secondary-parent routing more cleanly for long merge edges
  • Integrates directly into the existing Git Log UI
  • Activates automatically when the Git / Version Control tool window is opened

The plugin focuses on graph rendering only, so your normal Git Log workflow stays the same and no extra configuration is required.
